Overview.p: S3 security has layers: identity (IAM), resource policies, Block Public Access, encryption, network controls and logging.
Many locks on the same locker: who you are, what the rules say, no public door, and a safe inside.
A fintech keeps all buckets private, encrypts with KMS and logs every access.
